import collections


def noise_cells(g):
    """Cells whose 4-neighbors all differ from their own color."""
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    out = set()
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            nb = [g[y][x] for y, x in ((i-1, j), (i+1, j), (i, j-1), (i, j+1))

            if nb and all(v != g[i][j] for v in nb):
                out.add((i, j))
    return out


def background_color(g):
    """Most common color in the grid."""
    return collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]


def grow_rect(g, c, y, x, wild):
    """Maximal axis-aligned rect of color c (wild set = wildcard cells), grown from (y,x)."""
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = y, y, x, x
    def okrow(r, a, b): return all(g[r][k] == c or (r, k) in wild for k in range(a, b+1))
    def okcol(k, a, b): return all(g[r][k] == c or (r, k) in wild for r in range(a, b+1))
    ch = True
    while ch:
        ch = False
        while r0-1 >= 0 and okrow(r0-1, c0, c1): r0 -= 1; ch = True
        while r1+1 < h and okrow(r1+1, c0, c1): r1 += 1; ch = True
        while c0-1 >= 0 and okcol(c0-1, r0, r1): c0 -= 1; ch = True
        while c1+1 < w and okcol(c1+1, r0, r1): c1 += 1; ch = True
    return r0, c0, r1, c1


def rect_touch(g, i, j, r0, c0, r1, c1, c, wild):
    """True if cell (i,j) is a hole in, or a full-segment one-row/col extension of, the rect."""
    if r0 <= i <= r1 and c0 <= j <= c1:
        return True
    if (i == r0-1 or i == r1+1) and c0 <= j <= c1 and \
       all(g[i][k] == c or (i, k) in wild for k in range(c0, c1+1)):
        return True
    if (j == c0-1 or j == c1+1) and r0 <= i <= r1 and \
       all(g[k][j] == c or (k, j) in wild for k in range(r0, r1+1)):

    return False


def complete_rectangles(g):
    """Recolor noise cells into adjacent solid rectangles (or background/neighbor fallback)."""
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = background_color(g)
    noise = noise_cells(g)

    for (i, j) in noise:
